## September 3 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 667)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 3** across Hollywood's premier radio stage adaptations, precocious child comedy, and hit parade musical showcases, three star-studded *Lux Radio Theatre* productions for Lux Toilet Soap (*Maytime* with Jeanette MacDonald and Nelson Eddy in 1944, *The Enchanted Cottage* with Robert Young and Dorothy McGuire in 1945, and *Payment on Demand* with Bette Davis in 1951), Fanny Brice and Hanley Stafford on *Maxwell House Coffee Time* (1942), and Mark Warnow on *Your All-Time Hit Parade* (1942–1951):
